newsItems.title: Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy puts Nvidia’s China ambitions under scrutiny
newsItems.summary: Jensen Huang’s alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy threatens to complicate Nvidia’s lobbying efforts to loosen U.S. chip export restrictions and maintain access to China’s lucrative AI market.

newsItems.title: Nancy Pelosi’s replacement is ready to regulate AI
newsItems.summary: As a California state senator, Scott Wiener authored legislation aimed at curbing the risks of advanced AI. Now, after winning a tight congressional race for former Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi’s open San Francisco seat, he could play a key role in setting federal AI policy…
newsItems.whyItMatters: 监管与司法判例会直接改变模型训练、产品上线和企业合规成本。
newsItems.titleZh: 南希·佩洛西（ Nancy Pelosi ）的继任者已经准备好监管
newsItems.summaryZh: 作为加利福尼亚州参议员，斯科特·维纳（ Scott Wiener ）撰写了旨在遏制先进人工智能风险的立法。 现在，在赢得前众议院议长南希·佩洛西(Nancy Pelosi)在旧金山的空缺席位后，他可以在制定联邦人工智能政策方面发挥关键作用……
